classification.difficultyReason: Distinguish coordinate averages for midpoint from coordinate differences for gradient and length, then use those differences appropriately as a signed ratio or squared lengths.

content.prompt: Find the midpoint, gradient, and length of these line segments. Give lengths to 1 d.p.

spec.description: First-quadrant unit grid with labelled endpoints and supplied midpoint cue. Origin O is omitted under the house graph convention.
spec.mathematics: Grid x=0..7, y=0..8; numbered ticks 2,4,6 on both axes; A=(2,3), B=(5,7), marked M=(3.5,5).
spec.answerVisibility: Endpoints and the source midpoint cue remain visible; numerical responses appear only in answers.
